column3: “In that year” is rendered “in the same year.”
“I will break” is rendered as past, “I have broken.”
“Within two years” is close; “years of days” is rendered “two years.”
“You will make” follows the Hebrew; the LXX reads “I will make.” NASB has “you have made.”
“Cast you out” is rendered “remove you,” and “spoken rebellion” as “counseled rebellion.”
